name: Dining Misconduct
steps: Tap the man’s feet on the table to stop bad manners.
Tap the trash on the floor to remove littering.
Tap the woman to stop her from spilling food.
Tap the woman again to stop her from stealing food.
Tap the boy when he steals the lemon.
Tap the boy when he stands on the chair.
Tap the bill folder when he refuses to pay.
Tap the man when he harasses the waitress.
Tap the dog on the table to remove it.
Tap the man when he shouts at staff.
Tap the man’s mouth when bad breath appears.
Tap the toilet trap to finish the level.
